sloka: भरतेन तु सार्धं ते यान्तु सैन्यानि चाग्रतः ।नैगमा बलवृद्धाश्च द्विजाश्च सुसमाहिताः ।। ७.९१.२३ ॥
transliteration: bharatena tu sārdhaṁ te yāntu sainyāni cāgrataḥ ।naigamā balavṛddhāśca dvijāśca susamāhitāḥ ।। 7.91.23 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, let the armies go forth with Bharata, and also the merchants, the strong and old, and the well-prepared Brahmins.
